one last letter, just for you

Mi amor, you found every little note, but there will never be enough words to tell you how much I love you. I know these days have been tiring, and I wish I could make every difficult moment easier. Even when I can’t be there in person, please know that you never have to earn my love by being productive, cheerful, or strong. I love you on your quiet days, your overwhelmed days, and all the beautiful days in between. I am so proud of the woman you are, and I am grateful for every memory we have made together. Since March 4, 2026, loving you has been one of my favorite parts of life. I cannot wait for all the ordinary and extraordinary days still ahead of us. Until our next hug, come back here whenever you need a little piece of my heart.

Con todo mi amor,
Trevor ♡
